examined_formations.title: ROBOT_EVENT_RENTAL_META_ROUTER
examined_formations.chinese_title: 机器人活动租赁跨平台路由
examined_formations.attraction_summary: Both sides visibly move: event buyers are renting instead of buying and suppliers seek utilization; holiday orders surged and popular models became scarce.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Qingtianzu already operates a multi-brand supplier-demand platform and matches orders using distance, inventory and provider fulfillment data; JD and other rental channels are active. Delivery commonly includes transport, setup, engineers and on-site operation, so a new meta-layer would either duplicate incumbent matching or inherit recurring human fulfillment.

examined_formations.title: INBOUND_VISITOR_LOCAL_LIFE_ORCHESTRATOR
examined_formations.chinese_title: 入境游客本地生活总路由
examined_formations.attraction_summary: Inbound visitors have strong immediate spending and coordination needs across payment, transport, tickets, hotels, tax refund and multilingual guidance.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Beijing's GO BEIJING already aggregates 39 services across food, lodging, transport, sightseeing, shopping, entertainment and public services inside Alipay International, including ride-hailing, tickets, hotels, foreign-card/payment support, tax refund and multilingual guidance. The broad orchestration surface is being internalized by city/payment-platform infrastructure.

examined_formations.title: AI_GLASSES_CROSS_BRAND_TRY_BEFORE_BUY_NETWORK
examined_formations.chinese_title: AI智能眼镜跨品牌先试后买网络
examined_formations.attraction_summary: Smart-glasses sales are rising quickly and consumers benefit materially from physical try-on, optical fit and scenario experience before purchase.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Brand stores and optical retailers already expose dense trial surfaces. XREAL publishes many try-on locations, while Doctor Glasses opened a multi-brand smart-glasses concept store integrating experience, purchase and fitting. The experience gap is real but is being vertically internalized by brands and retail channels.

examined_formations.title: EVENT_DAY_MICROSERVICE_CAPACITY_ROUTER
examined_formations.chinese_title: 演唱会赛事日临时服务容量路由
examined_formations.attraction_summary: Large events trigger time-bounded cross-city demand for food, lodging, styling, props, storage, transport and local experiences, with visible spillover spending.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Ticket-root programs already connect attendees to hundreds of merchants and city attractions using ticket verification. The remaining fragmented microservices are mostly human-delivered and locally heterogeneous, making a new router dependent on continual merchant acquisition, quality control and manual service fulfillment.

examined_formations.title: HOME_CARE_TRUST_AND_CAPACITY_ROUTER
examined_formations.chinese_title: 居家照护可信供需容量路由
examined_formations.attraction_summary: Elder care, maternal care and domestic-service demand is urgent and users actively seek trustworthy supply.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current policy and infrastructure are explicitly building community/online matching and unified credit verification while the delivered value remains human care work. A third-party layer would not own the core service and would inherit ongoing supply vetting, matching and service-quality operations.
